name.en: Raid Duel - The Netherworld Cometh: Wiraqocha Rasca!

notes: The following rewards were awarded during this event, based on event points accumulated over the its course:

rows.text:
Raid Duel - The Netherworld Cometh:
Wiraqocha Rasca! Completed (Title)

notes: Every time the player defeats the Earthbound Immortal, they will be awarded with Treasure Boxes of different types.
"Oracle of the Sun" is also available in Rainbow Treasure Boxes dropped by defeating the Earthbound Immortal Level 2000.

rows.text:
"Roar of the Earthbound Immortal" (SR), "Sun Dragon Inti" (SR), "Moon Dragon Quilla" (SR), "Apocatequil" (SR)
20 or 10 EX Jewels (Raid Duel)
20, 10, or 5 Gems

"Roar of the Earthbound Immortal" (SR), "Sun Dragon Inti" (SR), "Moon Dragon Quilla" (SR), "Apocatequil" (SR), "Supay" (R), "Fire Ant Ascator" (R), "Call of the Reaper" (R)
5 or 3 EX Jewel(s) (Raid Duel)
5 or 1 Gem(s)
1000 or 400 Gold

"Supay" (R), "Fire Ant Ascator" (R), "Call of the Reaper" (R), "Ganigumo" (N), "Lord of Zemia" (N)
1 EX Jewel (Raid Duel)
200 or 50 Gold
7 or 3 Gate Keys (White, Black, Blue, Red, Yellow, or Green)

notes: The Card Trader EX appears during this event and remained open until one week after its conclusion. The player can trade their EX Jewels for cards, Booster Items, Gold, and Skill Chips. Each card, Skill Chip and Booster Item can only be obtained once from the Card Trader EX during this event, but Gold can be obtained any number of times.
On December 6, 2019, the following missions were added:

rows.text: Play 15 Assist(s) in Raid Duel (surrenders are not counted.)
Play 30 Assist(s) in Raid Duel (surrenders are not counted.)
Play 60 Assist(s) in Raid Duel (surrenders are not counted.)
Turbo Duel the Earthbound Immortal 10 time(s) (surrenders are not counted.)
Card Sleeves: Sun Dragon Inti & Moon Dragon Quilla
Inflict 30000 or more points of damage in one Duel against the Earthbound Immortal.
Game Mat: Sun Dragon Inti & Moon Dragon Quilla
Win 1 Duel(s) with "Earthbound Immortal Wiraqocha Rasca" in your Deck, while playing as Dark Signer Rex Goodwin.
Summon "Earthbound Immortal Wiraqocha Rasca" 1 time(s) in Duel World.
Summon "Earthbound Immortal Wiraqocha Rasca" 2 time(s) in Duel World.
Summon "Earthbound Immortal Wiraqocha Rasca" 3 time(s) in Duel World.
Reduce your opponent's LP to 0 by inflicting battle damage with "Earthbound Immortal Wiraqocha Rasca".

notes: On December 7, 2019, the following missions were added:

rows.text: Play 1 Duel(s) in Ranked Duels (surrenders are not counted.)
Play 2 Duel(s) in Ranked Duels (surrenders are not counted.)
Play 3 Duel(s) in Ranked Duels (surrenders are not counted.)
